title: Eversong Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Eversong a recently updated two bedroom cottage on Tupelo street with a king primary and a guest bunk room that sleeps four, perfect for a Seaside family escape located directly in Seaside just a 2 minute walk to the beach and 5 mins to all things Seaside.
description_expanded: Description80 TUPELO STREETKING, 2 TWIN BUNKS (sleeps six total)Welcome to Eversong – A Charming Coastal Retreat in the Heart of SeasideTucked along the picturesque Tupelo Circle, Eversong is one of Seaside’s largest and most inviting two-bedroom guest cottages. Just 361 feet from the nearest beach access, this beautifully designed home is ideal for families seeking both comfort and coastal charm. With its serene setting, thoughtful layout, and close proximity to the Gulf, Eversong offers the perfect blend of relaxation and convenience.A Private Pathway to Coastal ComfortEnter through a private gate off Tupelo Circle and follow the brick-lined walkway that winds through lush landscaping to your secluded retreat. The front of the home faces the iconic Tupelo Gazebo, while the back opens to a peaceful sandy footpath leading directly to Rose Walk Park—a shaded, tranquil space perfect for children to play or for quiet morning strolls beneath the trees.Thoughtfully Designed First-Floor LivingInside, a bright marble-floored foyer welcomes you home. Both bedrooms are conveniently located on the first floor, making this layout ideal for families. The primary king suite offers a cozy reading chair, built-in shelving, dual closets, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Its newly renovated ensuite bathroom features a deep soaking tub and sleek quartz vanity—perfect for unwinding after a day in the sun.Across the hall, the cheerful bunk bedroom comfortably sleeps four with two twin bunk beds. This room also includes its own updated ensuite bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and single vanity, offering comfort and privacy for guests of all ages.Light-Filled Living & Elevated Coastal StyleUpstairs, the home opens into a bright and airy living space designed for gathering and relaxing. Sunlight pours through the windows, illuminating the open-concept layout. The fully equipped kitchen features custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and playful retro accents—including a colorful coffee maker, toaster, and blender.The dining area seats six beneath soaring ceilings and a statement chandelier, while a convenient half bath is tucked nearby. The living room offers plush seating, including a large sofa and club chairs, along with a mounted flat-screen TV and Sonos soundbar—perfect for cozy movie nights after a day at the beach.Outdoor Living Surrounded by NatureJust off the living area, an open-air porch invites you to slow down and savor the moment. With Adirondack seating and a charming bench swing, this elevated outdoor space overlooks the treetops and is ideal for morning coffee or evening wine. A full-size washer and dryer add everyday convenience, while the backyard opens to a sandy path leading directly into Rose Walk Park—an idyllic, shaded retreat that feels worlds away yet remains close to everything Seaside has to offer.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.* Guest parking anywhere in the gravel along Tupelo St. Parking not permitted in the circle. FEATURES1,454 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space361 feet (2-minute walk) to beach access at Tupelo Pavilion, one of the largest private residential beaches on 30AFull-size washer and dryer for added conveniencePeacock Alley linens – fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes included (a golf cart is considered a vehicle; golf carts for non-homeowners are prohibited unless approved for medical necessity)No pets allowedSTR23-002008
